scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test:rooms: esbuild src/lib/room-store.test.ts src/lib/audio-signaling.test.ts src/lib/room-identity.test.ts src/lib/beam-membership.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=/tmp/room-backend-tests --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test /tmp/room-backend-tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:chat: esbuild src/lib/room-chat.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as createTestRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createTestRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=.tests/room-chat.test.mjs && node --test .tests/room-chat.test.mjs
